effect.name: Blur
effect.description: A round, single-pass blur. Alpha-weighted, so blurring a sprite does not drag dark fringes out of its transparent edges the way a naive blur does.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Quality
parameter.description: Rings of samples: 1 is 9 taps and fine for small radii, 3 is 25 taps and stays smooth at large ones.

parameter.name: Amount
parameter.description: Blends the blurred result back over the sharp original.
